aeon.name: Aeon
lines: **Languages** Utopian and other planar languages; envisioning for true aeons (_Monster Core_)

angel.name: Angel
lines: **Aura** Angels each have a unique aura based on how they serve as messengers and how they deliver those messages.

archon.name: Archon
lines: **Virtue Ability** Archons each represent a specific virtue, like courage or hope, and have a special ability based on the virtue they represent.

azata.name: Azata
lines: **Freedom Ability** Azatas each represent a specific freedom, like free expression or free love, and have a special ability based on the freedom they represent.

celestial.name: Celestial
lines: **Saves** often a +1 status bonus to all saves vs. magic

construct.name: Construct
lines: **Traits** Many constructs lack minds and have the mindless trait.
**Immunities** bleed, death effects, diseased, doomed, drained, fatigued, healing, nonlethal attacks, paralyzed, poison, sickened, spirit, unconscious, vitality, void; if mindless, add mental

daemon.name: Daemon
lines: **Death Ability** Daemons each represent a specific kind of death, like death by disease or starvation, and have a special ability based on the method of death they represent.

demon.name: Demon
lines: **HP** typically high to account for their multiple weaknesses

**Sin Vulnerability** Demons each represent a specific sin, like envy or wrath, and have a special vulnerability based on the sin they represent. This should be something the PCs can exploit through their actions, which should then deal mental damage to the demon. The amount of damage should be based on how easy the vulnerability is to exploit.
**Divine Innate Spells** usually 5th-rank translocate and at-will 4th-rank translocate
**Sin Ability** Demons also have a special ability based on the sin they represent, which either makes them better embody the sin or instills that sin in others.

devil.name: Devil
lines: **Immunities** fire; Weaknesses holy; **Resistances** physical (except silver), poison
**Divine Innate Spells** usually one 5th-rank translocate and at-will 4th-rank translocate
**Infernal** Hierarchy Ability Devils each have an ability corresponding to the role they play in the infernal hierarchy, typically focused around control or being controlled.

dragon.name: Dragon
lines: **Dragon Breath** Many dragons have an activity to exhale magical, damaging energy, with specifics determined by their theme.

fiend.name: Fiend
lines: **Saves** often a +1 status bonus to all saves vs. magic

fungus.name: Fungus
lines: **Traits** fungi without minds have the mindless trait
**Immunities** if mindless, mental; **Weaknesses** sometimes slashing or fire

incorporeal.name: Incorporeal
lines: **HP** terrible at lower levels, then low at higher levels
**Immunities** bleed, disease, paralyzed, poison, precision; **Resistances** all damage (except force, _ghost touch_, vitality for undead, or spirit; double resistance vs. non-magical)
**Strikes** magical trait, typically low or moderate damage

ooze.name: Ooze
lines: **Traits** Almost all oozes lack minds and have the mindless trait.
**Senses** typically motion sense and no vision
**Immunities** bleed, critical hits, precision, unconscious, often acid; if it has no vision, add visual effects; if mindless, add mental

plant.name: Plant
lines: **Traits** plants without minds have the mindless trait

swarm.name: Swarm
lines: **Traits** size based on the entire mass, usually Large or bigger
**Immunities** grabbed, precision, prone, restrained, swarm mind; **Weaknesses** area damage, splash damage; **Resistances** physical, usually with one physical type having lower or no resistance

undead.name: Undead
lines: **Traits** Almost all undead are unholy. Ghostly undead have the incorporeal trait. Undead without minds, such as most zombies, have the mindless trait.
**Immunities** death effects, disease, paralyzed, poison, sleep (or unconscious if it never rests at all); if mindless, add mental
